text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Running with everyone cheering for me 
really is the best. It helped me hold on 
right until the very end!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, Trainer-san. Could I get 
your notes on my fans' traits today too?
choice_data_list: I'll send it to your phone now

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At her request, whenever she had a race, I 
would always take notes on her fans and 
give them to her.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
...Mm-hmm... The folks I met at the event 
came today too, huh.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before signing a Trainer contract with 
her, we worked together as staff for a URA 
event.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Royce and Royce was trying her hand at 
self-promotion even there.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Those event participants had come to 
cheer for her. In other words, the 
producing had paid off!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, I spot a few familiar faces from my 
debut race among the crowd.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
This person and this person too... Ah! 
They're the ones who called out to me when 
I was doing roadwork at Nakayama before!
choice_data_list: Oh, you remember that well, huh?
Oh, you remember that well, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Naturally. That's what these notes are 
for, after all."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Cross-referencing the official photos 
released by the URA with the details in my 
notes makes figuring out this much a piece 
of cake.
choice_data_list:
So you're doing that to remember your 
fans' faces?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Trainer, do you remember when we made 
those paper fans?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Hardcore fan acquisition strategy, Step 
Two! Today is the "step" in our hop, step, 
jump!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"The videos of the fans, the notes on fan 
traits... It's all—for the sake of the 
live!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Winning Live began. From the wings of 
the stage, I watched Royce and Royce's 
performance.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
~~♪ (Ufu, I spotted my fan♪ In that 
case...)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Here's・your・pay・back♡

text_block_list.name: Event Participant
text_block_list.text: Hau?!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
~~♪ (Looks like newcomers in this section. 
To show my gratitude for today's 
cheers...)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Rapid-Fire Barrage☆

text_block_list.name: New Royce Fan
text_block_list.text: !! W-Was that... meant for us?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: ~~♪ (Ah, that's from my debut race!)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad♪ Please keep cheering for me 
next time too♡

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Kyaaa~! No way, no way, just now! 
W-W-W-Was that to me!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For a while now, Royce and Royce has been 
spotting her fans and sniping them with 
targeted fan service.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
(! The fans, the penlights, they're all 
for me! And everyone's cheering with all 
their might!)

text_block_list.name: Royce's Dedicated Fan
text_block_list.text: Royce-chaaaan!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: (You are the best~~~~!)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: (Looking straight into their eyes—)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Th・a・nks♡

text_block_list.name: Royce's Dedicated Fan
choice_data_list:
(This is going to be an unforgettable 
memory, huh...)

(This is going to be an unforgettable 
memory, isn't it...)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Ufufufufu! That Winning Live felt 
absolutely amazing!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The fan who received the targeted 
fanservice was likely thrilled that their 
support got through and that they were 
recognized.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It surely made them want to root for her 
even more.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Royce-chan gave me a finger-point wink! 
I'm so glad I made this fan...!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"‘For real!? I'm gonna make a fan for next 
time too!’ Fufufu... looking good!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
“Still, it's not over yet. We still have 
the final touches left!”

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
And now for the jump in hop, step, jump! 
Let's play the 'Thank You Video for 
Everyone's Support'!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
"Royce totally remembered a fan's face!" 
"She knows how hard it is to make those 
fans, so maybe that's why she gives extra 
fan service to people holding them."

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
"I heard Royce's fan service is godly. Now 
I'm curious, maybe I'll go check her out 
next time."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
The whole cycle just loops infinitely. 
Ehehe, I've created a perpetual motion 
machine!!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"From now on, all you need to do is focus 
on fan service! The fans will take care of 
spreading the word!"
choice_data_list:
(Wh-whoa, that analysis is way too 
pro...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as planned, the fan base was steadily 
growing. Many were saying they'd bring 
cheering merch to join in next time.
choice_data_list: Which means more fan service, huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"If we do it just like the other day, 
won't we be unable to provide fan service 
to everyone?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Then let's look for other places where we 
can fit in some fan service!"

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: "U-Um... Trainer <username>."

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me for asking out of the blue, 
but... you aren't thinking of switching 
careers, are you...?
choice_data_list: Huh!? I wasn't thinking that at all!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
You're right! Please forgive my terrible 
rudeness!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
There was a whole pile of books unrelated 
to training, so I got the wrong idea... 
I'm so sorry!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Now that you mention it, with stuff like 
"Charming Public Speaking" and "Social 
Media Strategies for Influencers," it's no 
wonder people might question the job 
description.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, even now, she was gathering 
info on social media while waiting for 
videos to encode...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Which means this is also part of your 
work...? That's incredible. I have my 
hands completely full just mentoring 
Bitter Glasse and Little Cocon...
choice_data_list: Ah, that was thanks to Royce's advice—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer-san! Are you planning on 
doing even more work after this?
choice_data_list:
However, I haven't finished editing the 
video yet...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Let's see...? Ah, I see... If we install a 
plugin, it'll make processing this much 
easier.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I should have explained that far, 
shouldn't I? I'm sorry. I'll teach you the 
most cost-effective and time-efficient 
ways to edit videos and gather info.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
It would be troublesome if you were to 
collapse, Trainer. ...It is only with your 
support that I can become the "strongest."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Come on, let's head home for today. 
Starting tomorrow, I'm going to train you 
strictly!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
To think that happened... You two really 
are two peas in a pod!
choice_data_list:
Though it's hard to tell which of us is 
the mentor here.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
"That's why you're working so hard, isn't 
it? So you can support them outside of 
training as well."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Eventually, I'd like to be able to make 
effective suggestions even when 
self-producing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Because that... is what will lead her to 
become the "strongest"—!
